reportID.description: The ID of the report this expense belongs to.

type.description: The type of the expense (e.g. cash, card).

created.description: The date the expense was created.

modifiedCreated.description: The user-modified date of the expense, if it was changed after creation.

inserted.description: The date the expense was inserted into Expensify's system.

modifiedMerchant.description: The user-modified merchant of the expense, if it was changed after creation.

amount.description: The amount of the expense, in cents.

modifiedAmount.description: The user-modified amount of the expense, in cents, if it was changed after creation.

convertedAmount.description: The amount of the expense converted to the report's currency, in cents.

currencyConversionRate.description: The conversion rate used to convert the expense's currency to the report's currency.

categoryGlCode.description: The GL code associated with the expense's category.

categoryPayrollCode.description: The payroll code associated with the expense's category.

tag.description: The tag(s) associated with the expense.

tagGlCode.description: The GL code associated with the expense's tag.

bank.description: The bank account the expense was paid from, if applicable.

billable.description: String value indicating whether the expense is billable ("true" or "false").

reimbursable.description: String value indicating whether the expense is reimbursable ("true" or "false").

isDistance.description: String value indicating whether the expense is a distance/mileage expense ("true" or "false").

hasTax.description: String value indicating whether the expense has tax applied ("true" or "false").

taxAmount.description: The tax amount of the expense, in cents.

modifiedTaxAmount.description: The user-modified tax amount of the expense, in cents, if it was changed after creation.

taxName.description: The name of the tax applied to the expense.

taxRate.description: The tax rate applied to the expense.

taxRateName.description: The name of the tax rate applied to the expense.

taxCode.description: The tax code applied to the expense.

mcc.description: The merchant category code of the expense.

modifiedMCC.description: The user-modified merchant category code of the expense, if it was changed after creation.

receiptFilename.description: The filename of the expense's receipt, if any.

receiptID.description: The ID of the expense's receipt, if any.

receiptURL.description: The URL of the expense's receipt, if any.

attendees.description: Comma-separated list of attendee email addresses associated with the expense.

unitsCount.description: The number of units (e.g. miles) for a distance expense.

unitsRate.description: The per-unit rate applied to a distance expense.

unitsUnit.description: The unit of measurement (e.g. mi, km) for a distance expense.

unitsName.description: The name of the unit type for a distance expense.

createdAt.description: Derived cursor field: the parsed value of the created date for this expense. This mirrors Expensify's own startDate/endDate export filter semantics and is used to track/resume the export window.

updatedAt.description: Derived cursor field: the most recent of the created, modifiedCreated, and inserted timestamps for this expense.
